verdict.rationale: Helicone's docs show a Sessions feature that groups related requests to trace agent flows (helicone-docs-5, helicone-docs-6) and per-user cache namespaces (helicone-docs-13), which support some usage segmentation, but there is no explicit evidence of a general custom-metadata/custom-properties system for tagging requests by user, feature, or session to attribute cost and usage in dashboards or queries. Missing for 10: explicit custom-properties/tagging API, cost breakdown by user/feature dashboards, and documentation showing metadata-based cost attribution reports.
